purpose: Consume native CPU state commands in fixed GPU owners and compare original TieredKVCache promotion/eviction/reclaim. Component proof, no macro retry.
requirements: BF16 payload and F32 metadata bits exact versus original reference
CPU flags/positions and physical logical/free slots consistent with descriptor consumption
GPU metadata compacted before cold reclaim; original stable score/timestamp selection retained
CPU and GPU owner roots/padding preserved; commands consumed before reuse and stale commands rejected after reclaim
limits: Small synthetic GPU transitions, victim decisions explicitly supplied. Cold keep decisions come from original reference; independent retention-selection validation remains needed. Emulated physical KV slots are GPU tensors, not pinned CPU/native transfers or physical STT. No model, speed or whole-process memory claim.
